Author: Anil Kumar Upman
Bench: Anil Kumar Upman

Harinarayanpura Panchayat Kotkhabada, District Jaipur (Raj.)
 ----Petitioner
 Versus

 ----Respondent

1.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The instant pre-arrest bail application has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioner, who is having apprehension of his arrest in connection with FIR No.28/2023 registered at Police Station Khotkhabada, District Jaipur South for the offences under Sections 191, 193, 181,
420, 468, 471 and 171-G of IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that accused-petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
He submits that petitioner has joined the investigation in terms of order dated 11.09.2023.
He further submits that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not required in this matter.
He thus, prays that instant bail application under Section 438 Cr.PC may kindly be allowed.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor assisted by learned counsel for complainant opposes the bail application and submits that not only false declaration has been made by the petitioner but fake document has also been prepared by him.

4. Considering the contentions put-forth by the counsel for the petitioner and taking into account the totality of facts and circumstances of the case, especially the fact that petitioner has joined the investigation in terms of order dated 11.09.2023 and also considering the fact that there is dispute between the parties with regard to the election of Panchayat, but without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this court deems it just and proper to allow the anticipatory bail Mohan Lal Meena S/O Shri Jagdish Prasad ... vs State Of Rajasthan on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42273312/
1 application.
5.

entities.text: Mohan Lal Meena S/O Shri Jagdish Prasad ... vs State Of Rajasthan
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

The S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer, Police Station Khotkhabada, District Jaipur in FIR No. 28/2023 is directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioner - Mohan Lal Meena S/o Shri Jagdish Prasad Meena, he shall be released on bail, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/-
each to the satisfaction of the S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer of the concerned Police Station on the following conditions:-
(i) that the petitioner shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) that the petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to (3 of 3) [CRLMB-4174/2023] the court or any police officer, and (iii) that the petitioner shall not leave India without previous permission of the court.
(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J DEEPA RANI -137 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
